guidance.bestFor: The bare pattern: 3 density options, each dot tied to its label through id and htmlFor, Comfortable picked on load

whenNotToUse.when: One option shown but locked so it cannot be picked
Options marked in an error state after a failed check

guidance.bestFor: The density list with its preselected Comfortable option locked: the dot disabled, its label dimmed by the Field
agentNotes: On the base twin the `disabled` item alone leaves its label at full strength; `data-disabled` on its `Field` is what dims it

whenNotToUse.when: Options flagged as failing validation rather than locked

guidance.bestFor: Density options that each carry a one line hint stacked under the label inside FieldContent

whenNotToUse.when: A single heading and hint covering the whole set of options

guidance.bestFor: A 2 option Email or SMS choice shown in error, with data-invalid on each Field and aria-invalid on each dot
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` on each `RadioGroupItem` and `data-invalid` on each `Field` are hardcoded; set both from your validation and add an error line

whenNotToUse.when: An option that is locked rather than failing a check

guidance.bestFor: Options whose circles take a blue, green or yellow border through a className override on each item
agentNotes: The inner dot paints with a background color, so `text-blue-500` on the indicator never tints it; only each item's border takes the hue

whenNotToUse.when: Choosing a hue from a full spectrum or by typing a hex code

name: c-radio-group-6
title: Radio group with legend and description
label: Legend & Description
description: Radio group with legend and description

guidance.bestFor: A fieldset whose legend and hint title the whole set, here 3 battery levels with Medium picked

whenNotToUse.when: A helper line under every option rather than one for the set

guidance.bestFor: Two outlined plan tiles, Plus and Pro, a title and one line pitch left of a trailing dot, the whole tile clickable

whenNotToUse.when: Rows joined inside one card and split by separator lines

name: c-radio-group-8
title: Radio group in card with separators
label: Card Separators
description: Radio group in card with separators

guidance.bestFor: Shipping speeds as 3 full width rows inside one Card, split by separators, the dot leading each title

whenNotToUse.when: Separate outlined tiles, each with a short pitch under its title
Rows that open on a channel icon and end with the dot

name: c-radio-group-9
title: Radio group in card with icons
label: Card Icons
description: Radio group in card with icons

guidance.bestFor: Contact method rows in one Card, each opening on a muted mail, phone or chat icon with the dot at the far end

whenNotToUse.when: Plain text rows with the dot at the start and no icons

guidance.bestFor: Four language rows in a ReUI Frame, a Language title bar over one panel whose rows are split by separators

whenNotToUse.when: Settings rows in a titled panel that each turn on or off by themselves

guidance.bestFor: Four product area tiles in 2 columns, each an icon chip over a title and blurb, with the dot pinned top right
agentNotes: Replace `items` with your options; each `value` is also the `RadioGroupItem` `id` and `htmlFor`, so keep it unique on the page

guidance.bestFor: Two person tiles with avatar photo, name and handle, picking a single teammate through a trailing dot
agentNotes: `AvatarImage` pulls sample faces from images.unsplash.com; pass each member's photo URL, and their initials to `AvatarFallback`

whenNotToUse.when: A roster where several people can be selected together

guidance.bestFor: Saved Visa and Mastercard tiles with last 4 digits and expiry, plus an add new method tile, each with a corner dot
agentNotes: Picking the `new` tile only sets the value; open your add card form when the selection turns to `new`
`VisaIcon` and `MastercardIcon` are simplified inline SVGs and the digits and expiry dates are fixed strings; render them from saved methods

whenNotToUse.when: Subscription tiers that list a monthly price beside each name

guidance.bestFor: Public and private visibility choices whose labels end in a help icon that opens a longer explanation in a tooltip
agentNotes: On the base twin only the Public `Tooltip` sits inside `TooltipProvider`, so Private waits the 600ms default; wrap the whole `RadioGroup` in it
Neither help `TooltipTrigger` has a name, as each holds only an `aria-hidden` icon; give each an aria-label naming its option

whenNotToUse.when: Explanations short enough to sit as a line under each label

guidance.bestFor: Release channels where Stable wears a secondary Recommended pill and Beta a default New pill, Canary left bare
Admin, Editor and Viewer roles set side by side in one row that wraps on narrow screens, Viewer picked

whenNotToUse.when: A segmented row of pressable buttons with no dots

guidance.bestFor: Free, Pro and Enterprise tiers mapped from an array, each row pairing the name with a monthly price over a pitch
agentNotes: Replace `plans` with your tiers; `price` renders with a fixed /mo suffix and each `value` doubles as the item `id`

whenNotToUse.when: Plan tiles that carry only a name and a pitch, with no price
